title: Ham and Cheese Toastie with Fried Egg
summary: A classic French-style breakfast toastie with salty ham, melted cheese, and a runny fried egg on top. Crisp, rich, and ready in minutes for a satisfying morning meal.
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Place the bread butter-side down and layer one slice with the ham and grated cheddar, then top with the second slice of bread, butter-side up.
Heat a frying pan over medium heat and cook the sandwich for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until the bread is golden and the cheese has melted.
While the toastie cooks, heat the olive oil in a small pan over medium heat and fry the egg until the white is set but the yolk is still runny, or cook longer if you prefer.
Season the egg with a little salt and black pepper.
Serve the toastie hot with the fried egg on top or alongside.
